_README: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR /episodes. Josh supplies the real data. Every entry below has "placeholder": true and renders with a PLACEHOLDER stamp, a disabled play control, and no outbound link — so nothing here can be mistaken for a published episode. To publish a real episode: add an entry with "placeholder": false and fill every field. Delete the placeholders once real episodes exist.

_schema.title: string, required
_schema.publishedAt: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), required for real episodes, null for placeholders
_schema.youtubeUrl: full https URL to the episode on YouTube, or null
_schema.topics: array of category names, drawn from the site's six categories
_schema.placeholder: boolean — true hides links and stamps the card as not-yet-published

episodes.title: Episode 01 — Not Recorded Yet
episodes.summary: This is a placeholder card showing how an episode will appear once the show starts publishing. It is not an episode, and nothing has been released.

episodes.title: Episode 02 — Not Recorded Yet
